title: Auf Fahrbahnen zugerannt und Widerstand geleistet – DEIG-Einsatz

extraction.summaryEn: A 29-year-old man in a psychological crisis ran toward vehicles on Blumberger Damm and then resisted police and paramedics during transport to hospital. A police officer used a stun device (DEIG) on him after warning him; he was not injured and was admitted to psychiatric care.
